description: Alternative text is present but is inaccurate, misleading, or does not correctly describe the content or purpose of the image.
Captions are present but do not accurately represent the spoken content or meaningful audio information in the video.
A valid page-level lang attribute is present, but its value does not match the actual language of the page content.
A valid language declaration is present for a passage or component, but it does not match the actual language of that content.
Link text or its accessible name is present but does not accurately describe the destination or purpose of the link.
A button has a label or accessible name, but it does not accurately describe the action or result produced by activating the button.
A form control has a label, but the label does not accurately describe the control's purpose or the information expected from the user.
supplementary_information: Form control, surrounding context, and expected input

description: A labeled interactive widget, such as a tab, menu item, tree item, accordion, or custom control, has a label that does not accurately describe its content, purpose, or resulting action.
A heading is present but does not accurately describe the topic or purpose of the content it introduces.
A landmark is structurally valid, but its role or accessible label does not accurately describe the actual purpose of the region.
supplementary_information: Landmark content and surrounding document structure

description: A page title is present but does not accurately describe the topic or purpose of the page.
An input has a syntactically valid autocomplete value, but that value does not correspond to the actual purpose of the field.
supplementary_information: Form-field label, expected input, and form context

description: A valid ARIA state or property is present, but its value does not correspond to the actual state of the interface, such as aria-expanded="false" for content that is currently expanded.
Table header associations are syntactically present but associate data cells with headers that do not represent their actual row or column meaning.
An error message is present but identifies the wrong field, describes the wrong problem, or does not correspond to the actual invalid input.
supplementary_information: Form values, validation state, and error message
